questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she [finish] her homework by Friday.
Select the option that correctly reports the following statement: 'I have just eaten lunch.'
options: He said that he had just eaten lunch.
He said that he has just eaten lunch.
He said that he was just eating lunch.
He said that he would eat lunch.
questions.answer: He said that he had just eaten lunch.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the action? The committee decided to change the policy.
options: It was decided by the committee to change the policy.
The policy was being changed by the committee.
The policy was decided by the committee to change.
The committee decided changing the policy.
questions.answer: It was decided by the committee to change the policy.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct conditional form: If I ______ more time, I would travel around the world.
Choose the best collocation: He gave a ______ report on the findings.
Select the correct dependent preposition: We are going to proceed ______ the plan unless there are any objections.
Which of the following sentences uses the discourse marker correctly to express concession? Although ______ the weather was bad, they decided to go.
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: I’m afraid I can’t come to the meeting tomorrow because I have an ______ appointment.
Select the appropriate word to complete the phrase: It’s ______ to say, but I think he’s not telling the truth.
Which sentence correctly uses the past perfect continuous to report an action? By the time she arrived, we ______ for two hours.
